note: Pinned snapshot of the Matt Pocock skills the Launchrail workflow composes, vendored as managed files (ADR-0019). Refresh deliberately: re-pull upstream at a new commit, re-copy these skill directories, bump `commit`, and re-diff the `overrides` below against upstream to absorb anything material. Skills keep their bare upstream names so their cross-references stay intact and the sync stays simple.

overrides.implement: Not vendored — superseded by Launchrail's launch-implement front door (ADR-0018/0019), which is a strict superset (TDD at named seams, the verify gate, /code-review with fixes, PR/CI/merge lifecycle). Re-diff upstream implement on each refresh in case it grows substance worth folding into our front door or ralph-implement.
overrides.resolving-merge-conflicts: Not vendored — Launchrail ships its own launch-resolving-merge-conflicts tied to the Ralph loop's parallel-implementer protocol.
